georgia-military-highway.slogan: Tbilisi to Vladikavkaz · one way, about 348 km back to the start

sections.advice: Tbilisi → Ananuri is 64 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Ananuri → Gudauri is 49 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Gudauri → Jvari Cross Pass climbs about 2379 m in 4 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Jvari Cross Pass → Stepantsminda drops about 2379 m over 29 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Stepantsminda → Vladikavkaz is 51 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Georgian Military Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2379 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

georgia-military-highway.story: A one-way ride of 348 km, Tbilisi to Vladikavkaz - roughly 4 h 43 in the saddle. The stops in between: Ananuri, Gudauri, Jvari Cross Pass and Stepantsminda. The highest point is about 2,750 m. It crosses from Georgia into Russia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
